thesis: The episode introduces Simeon McMillan, a former operator and investor with experience at Univision Networks and MediaCo, to discuss the history and structure of the US broadcast television industry. The discussion outlines the evolution from the pre-internet hub-and-spoke model of the big four networks to the current landscape, explaining how the FCC's 39% rule limits network ownership and necessitates a reliance on local affiliate stations for national reach.
